resources.string: Online subtitles need your own OpenSubtitles API key. Add it under “Advanced options”.
Set the city for the weather. Blank uses the approximate location from our server; on a VPN it may be off. Then enter your city (e.g. London) or "lat,lon" (e.g. 51.5,-0.12).
Leave blank to use the approximate location from our server. Enter a city (e.g. London) or "lat,lon" (e.g. 51.5,-0.12).
